newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Uzbekistan gets $50 mln ADB loan.
newsitem.headline: Uzbekistan gets $50 mln ADB loan.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) on Tuesday approved a $50 million loan to rehabilitate and modernise 25 to 50 small and medium agro-processing firms in Uzbekistan.
The loan will enable these units to access new export markets, the Manila-based multilateral agency said in a statement.
A separate $830,000 grant was also approved for institutional strengthening of Uzbekistan's National Bank for Foreign Economic Activity, the ADB said.
The bank said agriculture played a key role in Uzbekistan's economy, accounting for nearly 30 percent of gross domestic product and 45 percent of total employment.

Until 1991, as part of the Soviet Union, Uzbekistan was an important source of fresh and processed fruit and vegetables to the other republics. But since independence, rural firms in Uzbekistan have faced a severe cash and credit crunch, it said.
The project to improve conditions for this sector is estimated to cost $87 million. The ADB loan carries an interest rate of 6.82 percent.
